notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
What's new:
deadzone for joystick(you can now clamp hardware values and final output from steering to reduce flickering on analog inputs) 
ability to play the game with xbox 360(added ability to map half of input, guide on how to will be added later on)
applied newton fix(people who don't have sse4 capable CPU experienced crashes, now that is fixed)
applied missing dlls fix+added vs2015 redistributable to steam auto-install.
added EDIT_MAP.bat that opens map editor to show modders how to do it
